249713|0c768ee1.name: Odd Child
249713|0c768ee1.text: Shhh! You'll give away my hiding spot!

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

741-progress.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-progress.text: What can I do for you, $r?
741-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

87760-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
87760-complete.text:
This has been a long journey, $N, but it was worth it.

At long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.

Thank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.
87760-complete.title: Holy Diver

87760-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
87760-progress.text: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
87760-progress.title: Holy Diver

951-progress.name: Onu
951-progress.text: $N.  Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
951-progress.title: Mathystra Relics

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

98013-complete.name: Arbal
98013-complete.text:
Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...

It is unforgivable.
98013-complete.title: Swelling Forces

98028-accept.name: Unknown
98028-accept.text:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028-accept.title: Baron Marinous

98028-complete.name: Onu
98028-complete.text:
<Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>

Stairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be?

<Onu shakes his head.>

I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
98028-complete.title: Baron Marinous

98028-progress.name: Onu
98028-progress.text: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $r... what have you brought me?
98028-progress.title: Baron Marinous
